fact: Phase II of the civil status modernisation project, signed 2 July 2024, aims to implement a biometric national identity built on civil registration as the foundation of legal identity, and phase I produced a study on the links and interconnection of civil registers with public registers toward a future population register.
title: Consultant international chargé d’élaborer le projet de décret devant régir l’Agence Nationale de l’Etat civil aux Comores et les centres d’état civil, 3 mois
